description: This file defines a TypeScript module for an image analysis tool within a larger AI or media processing project. It includes functions for resolving image model configurations, loading images from various sources, and executing image description prompts. It also exports a factory function to create an image analysis tool with configurable options.

methods.name: resolveImageToolMaxTokens
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of tokens for image model processing, defaulting to 4096 if the model's max tokens are not specified or invalid.

methods.name: resolveImageModelConfigForTool
methods.description: Determines the effective image model configuration, preferring explicit settings and falling back to default or auto-detected models based on provider capabilities.

methods.name: pickMaxBytes
methods.description: Calculates the maximum byte size for image loading based on configuration or default limits.

methods.name: runImagePrompt
methods.description: Executes an image description prompt using loaded images and a specified model, returning descriptive text and attempt details.

methods.name: createImageTool
methods.description: Factory function that creates an image analysis tool with configurable options such as model, sandboxing, and workspace settings.
